candidates.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I have great news! Century Spring has reviewed your work and would like to schedule a meeting with you. They want to hear more about your background and share some context about their company and brand. Please tell me whether you’re available for a call this week.

The team also shared feedback and suggested edits for your test article, which are available here: [URL_003]

Let me know if anything is unclear or if you have questions!

In addition to arranging this meeting, my team wants to give you your next copywriting assignment. Rather than creating a blog article this time, you’ll revise the copy on an existing landing page at [URL_004]. I can provide the brief tomorrow. Regarding your rates, approximately how many hours do you anticipate needing for a copy editing project?

Thanks!

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Excellent! I’ll share your availability with them and then follow up by sending a Google Meets invitation. Which email address should I use for the invite?

This is the specific landing page you’ll revise: [URL_005]. Just as with the previous brief, we’ll give you detailed directions about what we want included in each section.

At this point, we anticipate approximately 4 assignments per month. Because blogs are expected to require more time than copy-editing assignments, we may replace 1 blog with 2 copy-editing tasks when necessary.
